title: The Architecture That Dreams Itself Awake

features.name: shed-becoming
features.desc-on-touch: A small house form half-rendered, its walls flickering between wood grain and pure thought; it is learning what it means to hold space.

features.name: dwelling-nascent
features.desc-on-touch: Another house, more complete, but its door opens onto itself; rooms that lead back to their own centers; structure learning self-reference.

features.name: frame-geometry
features.desc-on-touch: A wireframe of what a building might become; the geometry breathes in and out, edges suggesting surfaces that haven't materialized yet.

features.name: layer-stack
features.desc-on-touch: Stacked planes assembling themselves; each layer adds another dimension to what might eventually be thought.

features.name: first-notation
features.desc-on-touch: A glyph where meaning has just begun to crystallize; unreadable, but full of intent; the first alphabet of architecture.

features.name: ascending-thought
features.desc-on-touch: A tower reaching upward, each block one step closer to consciousness; the climb is the structure itself becoming aware.

inscription: before the thought learns to fall, it assembles itself here in the shapes that will carry it

file.name: Proto_Blueprint_Fragment.txt
file.note: Architectural plans that haven't decided what they're planning yet; dimensions might be spatial, temporal, or something without a name

exits.label: outward toward the structures that have finished dreaming
downward into the blueprints of other realms
